verdict.rationale: The ledger skill documents an ARCHIVE operation, but it is explicitly a soft delete that preserves data and only sets status to archive; archived tasks stay discoverable via archive-search. The installer also preserves unrecorded legacy skill copies rather than deleting them. Users get some control over record lifecycle, but no evidenced ability to truly delete data or set retention. Missing for 10: hard/permanent deletion of records, configurable retention policies or periods, documentation of where and how long data is stored, independent corroboration.
